summary: All three requirements are substantially implemented. REQ-1 (frontend compression) and REQ-3 (share function) are fully addressed. REQ-2 (backend limit increase) shows the new result types in the truncated backend diff, but the actual 900 KB numeric constant enforcement in the Motoko code is not visible in the truncated diff, creating minor uncertainty.

missing_requirements.requirement: Raise the per-image blob size limit to at least 900 KB in the Motoko backend and return #imageTooLarge when exceeded.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows the new CreatePostResult and UpdatePostResult types with #imageTooLarge variants in backend/main.mo, confirming the typed error return. However, the file is truncated and the actual numeric constant enforcing the 900 KB limit in createPost/updatePost logic is not visible. It is unclear whether the hard limit was actually raised to at least 900 KB.
